class.name: RenderingUpscaler
class.brief_description: Base class for custom temporal 3D upscalers, such as vendor or neural network based upscalers.

method.name: _get_jitter_phase_count
method.description: Returns the length of the camera jitter sequence for the given internal and output sizes. If not overridden or if [code]0[/code] is returned, the sequence length recommended for FSR 2 is used ([code]8 * (target_width / render_width)²[/code]), which suits most temporal upscalers.

method.name: _get_upscaler_name
method.description: Returns a human readable name for the upscaler, used in messages. Defaults to the class name.

method.name: _is_supported
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if the upscaler can run with the current renderer, graphics API and hardware. If not overridden, the upscaler is considered supported when [method _upscale] or [method _record_native_commands] is implemented.

method.name: _record_native_commands
method.description: Called instead of [method _upscale] when [method _uses_native_commands] returns [code]true[/code]. [param command_buffer] is the native handle of the command buffer being recorded: a [code]VkCommandBuffer[/code] with Vulkan or an [code]ID3D12GraphicsCommandList[/code] with Direct3D 12 (it is [code]0[/code] on other graphics APIs). Record the upscaling work directly into it. All textures in [param parameters] are in a state suitable for sampling, except the output which is ready for storage writes. [b]Note:[/b] This is called on the rendering thread, possibly after [method _upscale] would have been called, while the frame is submitted. It must not call [RenderingDevice] methods.

method.name: _upscale
method.description: Records the upscaling of one view. Read the inputs from [param parameters] and write the upscaled image to [method RenderingUpscaleParameters.get_output] using the [RenderingDevice]. Called on the rendering thread once per view and frame.

method.name: _uses_native_commands
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] to receive the native command buffer in [method _record_native_commands] instead of using [method _upscale]. Useful to integrate SDKs that record their own GPU commands.

method.name: get_upscaler_name
method.description: Returns the name of the upscaler, see [method _get_upscaler_name].

method.name: is_supported
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if the upscaler can be used, see [method _is_supported].
